learningGoals: Learn to sort and classify everyday objects into different categories. 🧺
Count items in a group and record the information simply. 📝
Understand how to read basic tables and picture charts. 📈
Compare data to find out which is 'most' and which is 'least'. ⚖️
teachingTips: Ask your child to help you sort laundry by colors or clothing types (shirts, pants, socks). 👕
While traveling, count the number of red cars versus white cars and see which has more. 🚗
Create a simple table on the fridge to track how many glasses of water they drink daily. 💧
Always ask comparison questions like, 'Do we have more apples or bananas today?' 🍎

funActivities.title: Shoe Sorting 👟
funActivities.description: Bring out all the family shoes and ask them to sort them into groups: laces, velcro, and slip-ons.

funActivities.title: Fruit Chart 🍏
funActivities.description: Look inside the fridge and draw a chart on paper showing how many of each fruit you have.

funActivities.title: Color Hunt 🖍️
funActivities.description: Give them 2 minutes to count how many blue objects and red objects they can find in the room.
